name: tata_group_pairs_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-agent-3
thesis: The Tata group (30+ listed entities) has high within-group correlation driven by common brand sentiment, cross-holding structure (Tata Sons ownership), and shared investor base. TCS (IT) and Tata Motors (auto) are the two largest by market cap but have low fundamental correlation (IT exports vs domestic auto). However, 'Tata premium' sentiment creates intraday co-movement — when TCS rallies strongly, Tata Motors gets a sympathy bid from retail traders. The divergence between fundamental drivers (TCS tracks IT sector, Tata Motors tracks auto/JLR) and sentiment linkage (both trade on Tata brand) creates a pairs opportunity. Additionally, Tata Steel and Tata Power share macro sensitivity to industrial growth, providing a tighter pair. The inefficiency exists because retail traders apply 'Tata brand premium' uniformly, ignoring business-specific drivers.
universe: TCS, Tata Motors, Tata Steel, Tata Power, Titan, Tata Consumer
stock_filter: TCS: ADV > ₹800 crore. Others: ADV > ₹50 crore. Select pairs based on rolling correlation

other: sectoral return data for TCS (IT) and Tata Motors (auto)

indicators.name: group_sentiment
indicators.formula: median(cum_return) across all 6 Tata group stocks

conditions: spread_zscore < -2.0 (stock A underperforming stock B in pair)
pair_correlation > 0.3 (pair is currently correlated, reversion expected)
group_sentiment direction aligns with stock A expected recovery
group_sentiment direction aligns with stock A expected decline

entry.entry_price: market order both legs: long underperformer + short outperformer

exit.signal_exit: pair_correlation drops below 0.1 (stocks decoupling, pair thesis invalid)

risk.position_sizing: ₹50K per leg, beta-adjusted. Use TCS-Tata Motors pair as primary (most liquid)

filters.time_filter: no trades in first 15 min or last 15 min
filters.event_filter: skip if either stock has company-specific news/results today
other_filters: skip TCS-Tata Motors pair on IT sector result days or auto sales data days

edge.edge_decay_risk: Low-Medium — Tata group cross-correlation is driven by brand sentiment which is persistent. However, as businesses diverge (TCS vs JLR), fundamental drivers may overwhelm sentiment linkage.

weaknesses: TCS and Tata Motors have very different business drivers (IT exports vs auto/JLR). The 'Tata sentiment' linkage can break for extended periods when sector-specific factors dominate.
Tata Motors' DVR (differential voting rights) shares add complexity — some correlation is between Tata Motors ordinary and DVR, not with TCS.
The 6-stock group sentiment indicator weights all Tata stocks equally, but TCS (₹13L crore market cap) dominates group sentiment while Tata Power (₹1L crore) has minimal influence.
prior_art: Gatev et al. (2006) pairs framework. In India, Tata group pair trading is common knowledge among institutional traders. Bose (2007) studies Indian conglomerate stock correlations. Tata Sons cross-holding structure documented in annual reports.
notes: Best pairs within Tata group by correlation: (1) Tata Steel - Tata Power (industrial, 0.5-0.6 correlation), (2) TCS - Titan (premium brand consumer, 0.3-0.4), (3) Tata Motors - Tata Steel (cyclical, 0.4-0.5). TCS-Tata Motors is low correlation but high liquidity, making it the primary pair for intraday.
